description: Saskatoon is asked to apply for federal funding for fleet electrification.
If successful, $85,000 shifts from solar to fleet electrification.
Vehicle and EV roadmap budgets will increase by $1.45 million.
$337,400 from Environmental Sustainability Reserve will fund part.

chips.text: Funding will support electrifying the city's vehicle fleet and EV adoption roadmap.
